subject: STR-ORD quote, copy to colleague
body:
Dear team,

please quote Stuttgart (STR) to Chicago (ORD): 6 pieces of gear motors, 700 kg, 2.8 cbm, ready 27.11.2026, delivered to STR by us. Cheapest option, EUR.

I am out of office from tomorrow; please address the offer to my colleague Mr. Jens Hartmann, he will confirm the booking.

Best regards
Frank Maier
Purchasing
Schwaben Antriebe GmbH
